src/experiments/mainline04/semanticContract.ts:61-62 accepts title and description string fields
finding: Structural completeStatus=true does not establish correctness of the user-visible title or free description. Synthetic wrong prose can coexist with unchanged correct structured action/object/time/material facts and still receive that score. This is measurement coverage evidence, not proof that Candidate17/18 emitted these words.

minimalAlternatives.option: Use verified structured facts for the first user-visible task summary
minimalAlternatives.implementation: Construct title from grounded action/object and render time/material/condition fields from the same facts. Keep original free prose/raw separately traceable. Score the actual rendered first summary against the source; deterministic formatting is not silent factual repair.

minimalAlternatives.option: Keep generated free prose but cover it explicitly in whole-output judgment
minimalAlternatives.implementation: Add a versioned display-semantic rubric and negative examples before new output. Report structured correctness separately; unresolved title/description judgment makes user-visible whole correctness unknown. Use a bounded provisional developer review for development, not a compulsory new human research gate.

limitation: No browser rendering or canonical persistence claim made by this file.
